item.title: NYT: Bond Sell-Off Threatens to Squeeze Borrowers Around the World
item.description: Government yields are hitting multi-decade highs, reflecting anxiety about debt levels, deficits and inflation. The effects will extend to mortgages, business loans and other types of credit.
